notes: __ModuleLoader__ shim runs factory/apply; require resolves from the plugin runtime when the half ships dsh.client.runtime and from the shared host runtime when it opts into dsh.client.host_modules (React 18.3.1 only) — the full DSH reference module table (design-system) is still unavailable

feature: External runtime imports (dsh.client.external)

feature: Slot ordering hint
notes: order field respected by the shell tabs

feature: Plugin-shipped runtime/module table (bring your own React)
notes: dshr addition: dsh.client.runtime classic script runs before the bundle and publishes window.__DSHR_MODULES__; module-table bundles resolve require from it (verified with React 18.3.1)

feature: Shared host module table (React served by the host)
notes: dshr addition: dsh.client.host_modules makes the host page load one versioned immutable /v1/runtime/react-18.3.1.js artifact (React + ReactDOM UMD + bootstrap publishing window.__DSHR_MODULES__) instead of embedding ~140 KB in every host page; frames without host_modules stay network-free; each iframe still has its own JS realm

notes: dshr addition: with the shared host runtime a half registers a React component (ctx.slots.register(entry, Component)) rendered in one React root with an error boundary; props expose useTheme/useSession/useSessions/useHostState and wide (currently always true); ctx.get('sessions') gives a partial reference service; round 80 adds the bridge services reference plugins expect (ctx.get('slots') registry alias with entries(key), minimal ctx.get('locale'), ctx.inject(deps, callback) that only runs when every dependency resolves, and window.__DSHR_LAST_ERROR__ diagnostics); round 81 accepts React component types (React.memo/forwardRef objects carrying $$typeof), gives keyed registrations unique <slot>:<key> ids, returns the reference shape with component/options from ctx.get('slots').entries(key), supports ctx.locale.register(ns, dicts) plus a t() seat with {name} substitution, and disposes ctx.interval/ctx.timeout with the frame; the host runtime publishes a partial @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives shim (Button/StateDot/Tooltip/Icon/Spinner/JsonBlock/MarkdownText, 7 components); conformance n=4 with the real MIT @kt11/dsh-deepseek-balance, dsh-remote, @ruoyang/dsh-plugin-deepseek-balance and dsh-genui plugins;
